verdict: Organic profiles are your only active channel; paid is fully off.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, zero paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads, leaving your Google Business Profiles as the sole source of inbound activity. Combined, the three profiles produced 398 actions over the last 28 days — direction requests, calls, and web clicks — all from unpaid discovery. Engagement is softening: Forte Metals saw a 68% week-over-week drop in profile actions and Advance Grinding fell 25%, while O'Hare Precision posted a strong mid-period surge of 59% before trailing to zero actions in the final three days. Paid campaigns are being brought back online to provide a consistent lead floor and reduce dependence on organic signals that can shift without warning.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all locations in the last 28 days
paid ad spend this period — no Meta or Google Ads ran across any location
week-over-week drop in profile engagement at Forte Metals, the sharpest decline of the three

watch_item.issue: All lead generation is resting entirely on organic profile visibility, with no paid channels active to compensate when organic softens — as it has this week at two of three locations.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore a consistent lead floor across all locations.
